name: Hill Giant

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Greatclub attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock

description: Hill giants are dim, gluttonous brutes who raid farms and travelers alike, driven by an appetite that far outpaces their patience or cunning.
